messages:
Liam O'Connor: Heads up 1 — SummitGate asking for executive sign-off but CISO pushed back on key custody and network isolation. Need a quick internal decision thread.
Nina Park: What specifically did the CISO ask for?
Liam O'Connor: Two asks: HSM-backed keys (they referenced FIPS 140-2 L3) and no public egress from inference nodes. They want a deadline for our response before the Friday exec call.
Carlos Mendes: Short answer: hosted API can't meet L3 HSM or guaranteed no-public-egress. Private deployment into their VPC can satisfy the no-public-egress requirement. For HSM L3 we can integrate customer HSMs or partner HSMs in their environment but that requires infra coordination — estimate 3-5 weeks.
Rhea Kapoor: We can offer a mitigated plan for the POC: deploy Private in their AWS account with customer-managed KMS, enable strict audit logging and SIEM forwarding, and provide a documented HSM integration timeline.
ops-bot: infra-check: VPC deploy template v2 available. ETA for sandbox provision: 48-72 hours after INF ticket.
Nina Park: I'll prepare a one-slide architecture sketch showing Private in-customer VPC, KMS binding flow, and audit log pipeline.
Carlos Mendes: Also note we can provide SOC2 + recent pentest under NDA. If SummitGate insists on fresh pentest we should propose either customer-funded test or schedule it as part of onboarding.
Liam O'Connor: Pricing corner: they asked for a committed rate for 12 months. Don't want to lock pricing yet. Tentative approach: offer provisional POC credit and say commercial terms to be defined after technical acceptance.
Rhea Kapoor: I'll draft POC SOW language: 6-week POC, Private VPC deploy, customer-managed KMS, acceptance criteria: SAML SSO, audit export, sample latency tests.
Nina Park: Can someone upload a sanitized audit sample and the SAML metadata by EOD? That helps the CISO security review.
Carlos Mendes: I'll own the audit sample (anonymized) and the list of logs we can guarantee for 90 days retention.
ops-bot: note: adding HSM appliance inside customer VPC requires coordination with partner HSM vendor and procurement (lead time 2-4 weeks).
Liam O'Connor: Action items: Nina -> slide + demo plan; Carlos -> audit sample + HSM timeline; Rhea -> SOW + commercial placeholder; I'll coordinate exec invite. Target: have materials by 9am Fri.
Nina Park: Aiming for 6pm today for slide draft.
Carlos Mendes: Uploaded sanitized-audit-sample: https://redwood.share/sanitized-summitgate-audit.json
Rhea Kapoor: Draft SOW posted to /internal/sales/sow-drafts/summitgate-poc.md for review.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks all 1 will loop legal for NDA and schedule the exec.
Liam O'Connor: last_message_ts set to 1851004800 per thread.
